name: Buxlow School

areas.summary: Strong publicly visible evidence for curriculum (8 specific items). Listed provision includes physical education, including in science, mathematics, music, geography.

signals.text: Pupils experience a broad curriculum and develop knowledge and skills, including in basic literacy and numeracy, the sciences, humanities and creative arts.
Leaders ensure that pupils experience a wide range of other curriculum subjects, including in science, the humanities, the arts, physical education and technology.
 Pupils develop good levels of knowledge, skills and understanding across the curriculum, with particularly high levels in mathematics and music.
Some pupils, particularly those capable of learning more, do not make as much progress in some subjects as they could.

areas.narrativeSummary: The school website lists physical education, including in science, mathematics, music, geography. Information appears across 2 pages.

areas.summary: Strong publicly visible evidence for enrichment and extra-curricular activity (9 specific items). Listed provision includes physical education, including in science, music, art, in art, drama, such as music, mathematics. 2 items corroborated across multiple pages.

signals.text: Leaders ensure that pupils experience a wide range of other curriculum subjects, including in science, the humanities, the arts, physical education and technology.
We want to offer a wide range of opportunities, both academic and extra-curricular, so that all our children are endowed with the spirit to aspire and become twenty first century citizens.
Pupils make good progress from a wide range of starting points, especially in their communication, language, literacy and numeracy skills.
Seven pupils identified as being the most able or with special talents in the school’s population follow a modified curriculum in maths, English, art, or music.
The most able pupils or those with special talents receive additional provision in academic subjects or in art, music or sport.

Welcome to Buxlow School
Buxlow School is an independent specialist school for autistic pupils aged 4-11. Our provision supports students in small class settings with a low-arousal environment. Pupils benefit from tailored learning in the mornings and collaborative, wider curriculum activities in the afternoons.
Our Philosophy
At Buxlow, we view autism as a natural form of neurodiversity. Each child is unique — with a combination of strengths and challenges.
Embrace and understand the autistic perspective.

Inspired Learning Group
Buxlow School is part of the Inspired Learning Group (‘ILG’), a growing group of independent senior schools, preparatory schools, and nurseries in the UK. ILG enthusiastically supports each school in the achievement of excellence.
ILG strives to create safe and inspiring educational environments where children can grow into positive and impactful members of society who will, one day in turn, shape the outlook of the next generation. ILG’s schools and nurseries combine traditional values and forward-thinking ideas to help every single pupil realise their potential, so they are prepared to take on jobs that have not yet been invented.
PhilosophyILG believes, first and foremost, in putting your child at the heart of everything we do. We endeavour to provide educational excellence within a culture of care to nurture each pupil the best we can. We want to offer a wide range of opportunities, both academic and extra-curricular, so that all our children are endowed with the spirit to aspire and become twenty first century citizens.
ILG Founder, Mr. Amit Mehta
Amit Mehta started his business career at Fortune 500 Company Avery Dennison, quickly rising through the ranks to become a senior executive reporting directly to the CFO. Ten years at the company taught him a huge amount about what makes a successful enterprise tick, experience he then employed when setting off to try his hand at businesses of his own.Amit successfully built and grew two private equity-backed businesses, learning more about how to manage different teams, understand customer needs and to always aim to exceed expectations. With a young family in tow, Amit soon started looking for a new opportunity relevant to his changing lifestyle – something that would allow him to give back to the community and give him a greater sense of personal satisfaction. He decided to take over a group of three struggling schools and focus on turning their fortunes around – ultimately saving them from the brink of closure. The venture proved life-changing, as Amit realised he’d found his calling.Since founding the Inspired Learning Group in 2014, he has expanded the group’s portfolio of schools to 13 prep schools, 3 senior schools, 10 nurseries, and still growing.ILG is now Amit’s passion and being able to apply his business acumen to education is something that energises him every day. He loves working with children, teachers and parents to improve the quality of education, boost local communities and make a real difference to the lives of so many young children.
